Name: Steeping Tank
Notes: ROUND AN (your picks): drawn as its machine, which IS the button (assets/brewery/brewery_malthouse.png, PixelLab; layered in art_source/aseprite/brewery/). Was called Malthouse; the unlock name in Needs is unchanged. THE ORDER COLUMN IS THE MAP. Section 1 is the first building you walk to. It also decides what may feed what: a section can only be given something an EARLIER section makes, or something raw - otherwise the chain cannot be started and tools/brewery_check.gd says so.

Notes: ROUND AN (your picks): drawn as its machine, which IS the button (assets/brewery/brewery_boiling.png, PixelLab; layered in art_source/aseprite/brewery/). Name: Fermenting Vat
Notes: ROUND AN (your picks): drawn as its machine, which IS the button (assets/brewery/brewery_cooling.png, PixelLab; layered in art_source/aseprite/brewery/). Was called Cooling & Fermenting; the unlock name in Needs is unchanged. WAIT MIN and WAIT MAX are the lagering. The barrel is not yours the moment you press the button - it sits in the cellar for one to three turns, and a turn is a fixture. Set both to 0 and it is instant. BATCHES is how many vats the cellar has: ONE for free, and every one after that is unlocked. An achievement Reward of count:batches_cooling+1 adds a vat - see ice_house_two in Achievements.csv. That is the shape for the whole Brewery: the basic foundation is free and everything that makes it easier or bigger is earned.

Name: Bottling Machine
Notes: ROUND AN (your picks): drawn as its machine, which IS the button (assets/brewery/brewery_bottling.png, PixelLab; layered in art_source/aseprite/brewery/). Was called Bottling & Filling; the unlock name in Needs is unchanged. HOW MANY is why this section exists: one barrel becomes six bottles. That number is the whole economy of the Pub - raise it and drinks are cheap, lower it and every bottle is a decision.
